description: Validates AI-using scenarios for provider-neutral routing, resource boundary hygiene, embedding metadata safety, and AI Gateway adoption readiness.

levels.name: AI inventory unavailable
levels.description: The target appears to use AI but AI Gateway cannot produce a trustworthy inventory of its provider, model, resource, or embedding coupling.
entry_criteria: AI applicability is declared or detected.
exit_criteria: AI-relevant source, config, and persistence surfaces can be scanned.

levels.name: Resource boundary hygiene
levels.description: Direct provider HTTP calls and provider credential ownership are absent or explicitly flagged.
exit_criteria: No direct provider HTTP calls or provider-owned secret/url settings remain in scenario code.

levels.name: Role and policy conformance
levels.description: AI usage avoids concrete model catalog coupling and routes through role/profile policy rather than provider-specific names.
exit_criteria: Concrete model slugs and direct resource calls are either removed or covered by reviewed role-policy exceptions.

levels.name: Embedding data correctness
levels.description: Embedding/vector persistence records enough role, dimension, content-version, and migration metadata to survive model changes.
entry_criteria: Role and policy conformance is clean.
exit_criteria: Embedding-backed stores have explicit metadata and retarget strategy.

levels.name: Gateway adoption
levels.description: Generic text AI usage adopts AI Gateway profile contracts where those contracts cover the operation.
entry_criteria: Embedding and role-policy checks are clean.
exit_criteria: Gateway adoption signals exist or reviewed low-level exceptions are present.

levels.name: Operational assurance
levels.description: AI usage is clean, gateway-adopted, and ready for production assurance gates.

capabilities.label: Resource Boundary
capabilities.description: Provider HTTP, provider secret/url ownership, and resource-policy boundary hygiene.

levels.name: Boundary unknown
levels.description: AI boundary posture cannot be inspected.

levels.name: Boundary unsafe
levels.description: Direct provider HTTP or provider credentials are scenario-owned.
levels.next_unlock: Move provider calls and credentials behind resources or AI Gateway.

levels.name: Boundary governed
levels.capability_summary: Provider access is governed by resource/gateway surfaces.

capabilities.label: Model Policy
capabilities.description: Concrete model slug and role-policy coupling checks.

levels.name: Model policy unknown
levels.description: Model policy posture cannot be inspected.
levels.capability_summary: Model catalog coupling may be hidden.

levels.name: Model policy coupled
levels.description: Scenario code hard-codes concrete model slugs or direct resource roles without reviewed policy.
levels.capability_summary: Provider catalog changes can break the scenario.
levels.next_unlock: Use role/profile requests or resource-owned policy.

levels.name: Model policy clean
levels.description: Model catalog coupling checks are clean.
levels.capability_summary: Model selection can evolve behind policy.

levels.name: Embedding posture unknown
levels.capability_summary: Stored vector compatibility may be hidden.
levels.next_unlock: Readable schema, migration, or vector-store configuration.

levels.name: Embedding metadata unsafe
levels.description: Embedding dimensions or vector stores lack required metadata signals.
levels.capability_summary: Embedding model changes can silently corrupt retrieval.

levels.name: Embedding metadata clean
levels.capability_summary: Vector stores can be migrated intentionally.

capabilities.label: Gateway Adoption
capabilities.description: AI Gateway adoption and exception posture.

levels.name: Gateway adoption unknown
levels.description: AI Gateway adoption cannot be determined.
levels.next_unlock: Expose gateway calls or reviewed exception metadata.

levels.name: Gateway migration recommended
levels.description: AI signals exist without AI Gateway adoption evidence.
levels.capability_summary: Scenario may need migration to AI Gateway profiles.
levels.next_unlock: Adopt AI Gateway or document a low-level exception.

levels.name: Gateway adoption clean
levels.capability_summary: Covered AI usage is routed through AI Gateway.

ai.direct_ollama_http.reason: Provider call migration needs scenario-specific role/profile intent.

ai.direct_openrouter_http.reason: Hosted provider migration must preserve credential and routing policy.

ai.invalid_provider_secret_env.reason: Secret ownership changes require operator review.

ai.invalid_provider_url_env.reason: Provider topology replacement depends on the scenario's operation contract.

ai.concrete_model_slug.reason: Model role/profile mapping is a policy decision.

ai.hardcoded_context_window.reason: Context budget migration depends on operation semantics.

ai.hardcoded_embedding_dimensions.reason: Embedding schema migration requires data-retention judgment.

ai.embedding_metadata_missing.reason: Vector metadata repair depends on the stored corpus and migration plan.

ai.resource_gateway_missing_role.reason: Role policy must be added to the owning resource.

ai.gateway_not_adopted.reason: Gateway adoption requires scenario-owner migration review.

ai.unreviewed_exception.reason: Exception approval needs human ownership, expiry, and replacement-plan review.
